sources.title: Monzo Help - Interest on your savings with Plus, Premium, Extra, ...
Monzo savings review: Rates up to 5.15%

brands.evidence: Free plan: 2.80% AER. Extra: 3.15%. Perks, Plus and Premium: 3.55%. Max and Max Family: 3.80%.

client_claims.text: Free plan: 2.80% AER on the Instant Access Savings Pot (variable)
client_claims.note: Matches the free plan rate of 2.80% AER.

client_claims.text: Extra plan: 3.15%; Perks, Plus and Premium: 3.55%; Max and Max Family: 3.80%
client_claims.note: Facts only cover the free plan rate.

client_claims.text: The higher rates apply on balances up to £1,000,000.
Interest is paid on the 1st of the month.
Instant withdrawals, no minimum deposit and up to 20 different Savings Pots.
Cash ISA Pot rates match Instant Access Savings rates, e.g. 2.80% AER (variable) on the free plan.
client_claims.note: The 2.80% figure is for Instant Access Savings; the ISA is not covered.

client_claims.text: Select Access Savings Pot: 3.45% AER (variable) on lower plans, 3.70% for Perks and Max, £500 minimum to open.
Fixed Rate Savings Pot: 5.25% AER (fixed) for a 3-year term.
The paid plans also cost a monthly fee.
client_claims.note: Extra, Perks and Max are paid plans with monthly fees.
